jobs.title: Director, Strategy and Insights, Paramount Pictures
jobs.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the   power   to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

Overview:

If you're excited by the idea of influencing how some of the world's biggest movies are created and launched, then look no further. We're hiring a Director of Strategy and Insights to join us at Paramount Pictures!

At Paramount, our Strategy and Insights team sits at the intersection of consumer insights and creative strategy, shaping how upcoming releases are made, marketed, and distributed. This role offers rare exposure to the entire film slate, from original titles to iconic franchises like Mission: Impossible, Transformers, Sonic the Hedgehog, and A Quiet Place.

Within the studio, this team serves as the voice of the audience, understanding how moviegoers feel about our films and brands and translating those perspectives into strategies that help us tell stories that connect authentically. This role requires someone who can balance analytical rigor with creative intuition, and who can build genuine trust and influence with creative and marketing leaders — not just deliver findings to them.

As Director, you'll help drive how insights guide strategy for all Paramount Motion Picture releases and play a key role in designing and implementing the research that shapes creative direction. You'll report to the Senior Vice President of Global Strategy and Insights and work closely with teams across the studio.

Apply now and join us!

Responsibilities:

- Drive research findings into actionable strategies that guide Paramount’s full slate of releases

- Lead the division in developing qualitative and quantitative research to tackle key questions and challenges

- Manage research planning and delivery, including vendor management, questionnaire development, and reporting

- Design clear, dynamic visual documents that communicate research findings and data effectively

- Present research insights regularly at marketing strategy and management meetings, acting as a trusted, consultative partner to creative and marketing leadership

- Actively supply ideas and feedback in meetings, presentations, and brainstorming sessions

- Assess each motion picture’s target audience, opportunities, and challenges

- Monitor research trends and guidelines to implement innovative approaches across the studio, including evaluating competitive campaigns, expanding statistical analysis, and advancing AI use in research

Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in a related field with 8+ years in marketing, content, or audience research

- MBA or comparable advanced degree in social sciences, business, statistics, marketing, or a related field preferred, but not required where seniority and impact are clearly established

- Entertainment or related market research experience preferred

- Demonstrated ability to translate complex research into a clear point of view for non-research stakeholders, and to build trust and influence with senior creative and marketing leaders

- Excellent communication, presentation, professional writing, and problem-solving skills

- Shown project management and organizational skills

Additional Qualifications:

- Experience with data visualization tools and software

- Strong knowledge of movies and a passion for entertainment

Founded in 1912, Paramount Pictures works with talented filmmakers to produce and distribute entertainment around the world. The film studio’s iconic logo has opened some of the most successful and beloved films in cinematic history, including timeless classics such as The Godfather, Chinatown, Forrest Gump and Titanic; and blockbuster franchises such as Star Trek, Transformers, Mission: Impossible and Sonic the Hedgehog. Recent, innovative, break-out films such as The Wolf of Wall Street, Arrival, Rocketman, and A Quiet Place have added to Paramount’s film legacy. With a beautiful 65-acre lot in the heart of Hollywood, a worldwide network of offices and a culture of engagement, Paramount Pictures’ passionate employees ensure the studio continues to deliver creativity and innovation to a dynamic industry. Paramount Pictures controls a collection of some of the most powerful brands in filmed entertainment, including Paramount Pictures, Paramount Animation, and Paramount Players. PPC operations also include Paramount Home Entertainment, Paramount Pictures International, Paramount Licensing Inc., and Paramount Studio Group. Paramount Pictures is a subsidiary of Paramount, which connects with billions of people worldwide through its global brands including MTV, CBS, Paramount Network, Nickelodeon, Comedy Central, BET and streaming service Paramount+.

jobs.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

OVERVIEW & RESPONSIBILITIES
The Director, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) is a key finance leader supporting the global content licensing business, with primary responsibility for the financial planning and analysis of TV titles. Reporting to the Vice President of FP&A and managing a one staff in the US, this role partners with finance and business leadership to provide financial insights that support strategic decision-making. The Director is tasked with leading the annual budget, monthly forecasting, and Long-Range Planning (LRP) processes. The role also develops financial estimates supporting television series greenlight decisions and maintains 10-year Ultimate revenue forecasts for the assigned portfolio. This position regularly interfaces with senior management and collaborates across Finance, Sales, Strategy, Business Affairs, and Content teams.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
•    Lead the annual budget, monthly forecast, quarterly outlook, and Long-Range Plan (LRP) processes.
•    Analyze forecast variances, identify key business drivers, and communicate risks and opportunities to the executive team.
•    Partner with Accounting and Corporate FP&A to ensure alignment between forecasts, financial reporting, and planning assumptions.
•    Develop financial analyses supporting television series greenlight decisions, including revenue estimates and long-term profitability projections.
•    Own the development and maintenance of 10-year Ultimate revenue forecasts.
•    Partner with Sales, Distribution, Content Strategy, and Studio Finance to update long-term licensing assumptions throughout a title’s lifecycle.
•    Ensure Ultimate forecasts reflect current market dynamics, contractual changes, and performance trends.
•    Collaborate closely with Content Licensing executives, Sales, Business Affairs, Distribution, Production Finance, Strategy, Controllership, and Corporate FP&A.
•    Present forecasts, financial analyses, and business recommendations to senior leaders.
•    Translate complex financial information into actionable insights for business partners.
•    Assist in the preparation of management presentations including monthly forecasts, quarterly business reviews, and quarterly earnings preparation.
•    Provide coaching, mentorship, and oversight to ensure high-quality financial analysis and planning deliverables.
•    Identify and implement improvements to the forecasting methodologies, reporting processes, and financial planning tools.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
•    Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
•    10+ years of progressive experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, Corporate Finance, or Strategic Finance.
•    Strong background in budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, and financial modeling.
•    Experience supporting executive decision-making through financial analysis and business partnership.
•    Advanced Excel skills and experience with enterprise planning systems (SAP, Anaplan, Hyperion, Oracle EPM, Longview or similar).

ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
•    Deep familiarity with TV programming and industry trends.
•    MBA or CPA preferred.
•    Experience within the media, entertainment, television, or content licensing industry strongly preferred.
•    Previous people management experience preferred.
•    Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

jobs.title: FP&A Manager - Content Finance & Transformation
jobs.description:
FP&A Manager – Content Finance & Transformation

Budapest | 12-Month Fixed-Term Contract

📌 INTERNAL APPLICANTS: Thinking about making a move? Taking on a fixed-term assignment will NOT jeopardize your permanent employment. Under Paramount policy, internal transfers into fixed-term roles carry a guaranteed return to your previous or equivalent position upon completion. You retain full employment continuity—so you can step up, expand your scope, and bring your experience back.

The Opportunity

Shape how Paramount plans, funds, and measures its content—and help build the finance engine behind it.

We’re looking for an FP&A Manager to join our Content Finance team in Budapest. In this role, you’ll serve as the finance voice for Paramount’s US studio content portfolio, partnering directly with Content Finance, Acquisitions, and senior leadership on decisions that dictate what hits the screen.

Beyond portfolio strategy, you will be a key finance lead on our Oracle Fusion ERP implementation —designing how Paramount Finance operates for years to come across requirements gathering, UAT, data validation, and go-live. Few roles offer this rare double-impact: a seat at the table on major content investments paired with hands-on enterprise transformation experience.

Note on the contract: This is a focused 12-month window to drive meaningful change and gain standout resume experience. Depending on business needs, it can also open doors to future opportunities within Paramount.

What You’ll Do

-
Drive Portfolio Strategy: Lead budgeting, forecasting, and the 5-year Long Range Plan for the US studio content portfolio.

-
Turn Numbers into Stories: Deliver sharp performance analysis and clear variance commentary to senior executive stakeholders.

-
Power Content Investments: Partner with Content Finance and Acquisitions to model, evaluate, and advise on prospective content investments.

-
Lead System Transformation: Serve as the core Finance voice throughout the Oracle Fusion rollout—from business requirements and UAT to data validation and post-go-live optimization.

-
Manage Risk & Opportunity: Track content spend against approved budgets, flagging risks and opportunities early.

-
Streamline Operations: Identify and execute opportunities to automate and modernize finance workflows as we transition to Oracle Fusion.

-
Core Financial Execution: Support month-end and quarter-end close activities while delivering high-impact ad hoc business cases for strategic initiatives.

What You Bring

-
Experience: 5–8 years in Finance, FP&A, Accounting, or a related discipline.

-
Technical Mastery: Advanced financial modeling skills and Excel expertise.

-
Systems Exposure: ERP experience (ideally Oracle Fusion); prior exposure to implementations or finance transformation projects is a strong plus.

-
Cross-Functional Influence: Strong stakeholder management experience across international, matrixed, and cross-functional environments.

-
Communication: Exceptional ability to communicate complex financial insights clearly to both finance and non-finance audiences.

-
Adaptability: Comfort juggling competing priorities in a fast-paced media landscape.

-
Education & Languages: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field; fluent English.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

-
Health & Well-being: Private health insurance with access to top private clinics, health screening packages, and eyewear support.

-
Flexible Benefits: Monthly cafeteria package including SZÉP card, nursery support, and home loan assistance.

-
Professional Growth: Company-sponsored language courses following probation.

-
Paramount Perks: Exclusive pre-premiere movie screenings, weekly fresh fruit days, and a dog-friendly office environment.

We are expanding our Streaming Affiliate Finance FP&A team and looking for a Senior Analyst in Budapest to own financial planning and analysis for the EMEA & APAC regions . In this role, you will work directly alongside the Budapest-based Senior Director/Lead, serving as their key partner locally while collaborating with a high-performing international team across New York and London.

If you’re ready to turn complex financial data into strategic insights, drive regional business decisions, and thrive in an interconnected global business, we want to hear from you.

Where You Fit In & Team Structure

-
Local Partnership: You will be joining as the first analyst on the ground in Budapest, working directly with your Hiring Manager/Director. You'll have direct mentorship, clear visibility, and a strong local sounding board.

Overview:

The Paramount Skydance Corporate Development Group is responsible for sourcing, evaluating, executing, and integrating/separating the company’s strategic acquisitions, divestitures, investments, and joint ventures. The Manager role will work with team members and senior leadership throughout the Paramount Skydance business units to assess and execute external transaction opportunities and internal business-building opportunities. The Group has a process that governs the organization’s M&A activities. Within that framework, the individual is expected to work and make decisions with some level of independence. For unresolved issues, the individual is expected to recommend a course of action for discussion. The individual will have the opportunity to develop close working relationships with key leaders at and beyond Paramount Skydance, and as such will need to exercise good judgment and quick thinking.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- Collaborate with team members, senior management, business units, and outside advisors to identify and assess potential external transactions in the form of acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, minority investments, and business development opportunities

- Assist with transaction execution, including developing valuation analyses and transaction briefing materials and coordinating due diligence efforts

- Conduct research on target companies, competitors, and market dynamics to support opportunity evaluation

- Build financial and operating models; develop various financial analyses including discounted cash flow, merger analysis, comparable company analysis, precedent transaction analyses, and general financial statement analyses; present analytics to an executive audience

- Track current deal flow and proactive & reactive pipelines

- Build strong working relationships across the Paramount Skydance organization

Basic Qualifications:

- 3+ years at a top-tier investment bank or private equity firm preferred

- Bachelor’s Degree required (with preference for an MBA)

- Strong interest in the intersection of Media and Technology

- Deep financial modeling expertise with knowledge of accounting, corporate finance, and valuation

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

- Excellent research skills and ability to prioritize, synthesize, and present information in written format

- Attention to detail

- Ability to work skillfully and on multiple projects at once

- Comfort operating in environments with ambiguity and evolving priorities

- Strong interpersonal skills with the solid ability to persuade others, build consensus, and work in a team
